resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both say 1965; the Forest Lookouts list says 1966. The story gives 1965 with the 1966 date noted, since no source explains the difference.

notes_for_editor: Design and dates match the brief (L-4, 4.6 m; 15 ft is about 4.57 m). Destroyed-year conflict (1965 vs 1966) is left open. Search leads not read: a 1990 Payette fire history with a 1944-1989 fire list, and a 1968 Payette history manuscript (Hockaday); either could settle the year. No staffing history is in any source, so none is recorded. No photo URLs were found; firelookout.com credits the Richard Holm collection and USFS without links.
